market_overview: Across the evidence set, sentiment is broadly mixed to neutral with pockets of bullish bias, especially in rates, equities, AI, Bitcoin and the U.S. dollar. The global PSI of 54 and U.S. PSI of 57 signal limited consensus, while top movers show strength in GBP/USD, Dow, NZD/USD and the dollar index despite divergent headline tones. Conflicting coverage appears in most topics, reflecting balanced but unsettled views on central‑bank policy, inflation and geopolitical risk. The market picture therefore leans toward cautious optimism tempered by mixed signals across asset classes.
